name: d-mango-pack
prompt: A locked-off medium shot in a distributor's godown in the morning. A woman in her fifties with a grey-streaked braid, in a teal silk sari, holds a small yellow mango drink pack, turns it slowly in her fingers and reads the date printed on its top through her reading glasses, then lowers it and looks at the open carton of the same packs in front of her, thoughtful and a little worried. She does not speak and never looks into the camera. Dust drifts slowly in the soft light from the high windows; nothing else moves. Photorealistic cinematic footage, natural skin, natural hands with five fingers. Audio: the hum of ceiling fans in a large godown, the soft rustle of a carton, distant birds outside, no music, no voices.
